central_claim: Visual plausibility is not the same as restoration trustworthiness.

findings.evidence: 50 paintings, 5 painting categories, 250 damage cases, 200 non-zero local comparison cases.
findings.thesis_interpretation: The experiment provides a controlled basis for comparing restoration behavior across categories and damage types.

findings.evidence: LaMa won the refined majority vote in 155/200 non-zero cases.
findings.thesis_interpretation: Deep inpainting can outperform both classical interpolation and diffusion generation under reference-based metrics.

findings.finding: OpenCV Telea remains useful as deterministic baseline
findings.evidence: OpenCV Telea won the refined majority vote in 21/200 non-zero cases.
findings.thesis_interpretation: Classical methods remain useful for baseline comparison and can still win some controlled cases.

findings.finding: Stable Diffusion rarely wins reference-based majority vote
findings.evidence: Stable Diffusion won the refined majority vote in 1/200 non-zero cases.
findings.thesis_interpretation: Visual generative plausibility does not necessarily align with reference-faithful restoration.

findings.evidence: Sparse masked-region SSIM was invalid and was moved to mask_bbox_crop in the refined comparison.
findings.thesis_interpretation: Evaluation frameworks must align metric choice with spatial region and metric assumptions.

findings.finding: Stable Diffusion uncertainty exposes generative instability
findings.evidence: 40 cases were sampled with 4 seeds each, producing 160 outputs and multi-metric uncertainty summaries.
findings.thesis_interpretation: Diffusion restoration should be evaluated for stability across seeds, not only single-output visual quality.

findings.finding: Uncertainty and reference performance are complementary
findings.evidence: Uncertainty-performance quadrants distinguish unstable weak cases, unstable stronger cases, consistently weak cases, and relatively reliable cases.
findings.thesis_interpretation: Trustworthiness requires both reference-based accuracy and generative stability diagnostics.

findings.finding: SDXL excluded from full local evaluation
findings.evidence: SDXL feasibility audit showed local 6GB VRAM/runtime constraints.
findings.thesis_interpretation: The final controlled comparison is limited to feasible local models; SDXL remains future remote-compute work.
